name: Tamiya
desc: Shizuoka maker of plastic scale-model kits, radio-controlled cars and Mini 4WD racers, founded in 1946 and led by the Tamiya family.
products: Plastic model kits (cars incl. Formula cars, bikes, military, aircraft), RC cars, Mini 4WD, paints and tools
markets: Japan, with an American subsidiary (Tamiya America, Inc.) and worldwide distributors
fit_rationale: Motorsport scale-model and RC-car maker whose product range includes Formula cars; licensing and consumer promotions are a natural F1 tie-in, though company scale shown is modest.
category_conflict: potential: other F1 model-kit / toy licensees (LEGO holds an F1 deal)
outstanding: No revenue published; second Route C indicator not proven (360 employees is below 500)
